'''Zar Draya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Exarch]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. She commanded the [[Alderaan Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] above [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] until [[3631 BBY]], when [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] boarded the [[Star Fortress]] and killed her, overloading the [[Sun Generator]] and destroying the entire battlestation in process.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zar Draya appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the final boss of the Alderaan Star Fortress.
